name: Gas-fired industrial water-tube package boiler
description: Shop-assembled water-tube boiler with water inside the tubes and combustion gas outside, served by a steam drum and mud drum with downcomers and risers and a finned membrane furnace wall. Natural circulation and the separation of steam and water from the heated circuit allow much higher pressures and outputs than a shell boiler, and the design can fire natural gas, refinery gas or dual fuel.
